title: Price independent one-transvection chart pairs on retained center con…
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped negative result. On the retained 640-input center-contact graph, every ordered pair of one-transvection charts at two of the 184 variable contacts strictly raises the paid moment for every `0<theta<1`, by at least `1+7^θ-8^θ`. Assignments on a rank-8 edge are at least 2. Any edgeless set of such charts adds, including every subset of the eight singleton charts with the empty-chart contacts fixed.

This is not a construction and not a selected-frontier change. The pinned selected record remains `κ = 781451/250000000`.

Connected mixed labelings of three or more contacts, changed routes, native maps, endpoints, and helper returns remain open.

## Task and overlap

Base: `2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc`. Task: `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, scope changed. Priority revision 8.

Nearest work is PR #4867 / `research/sol1337-contact-frontier`, which proved single contacts, common-transvection adjacent pairs, and coherent blocks of the empty chart. This package prices the independent chart pairs that proof left open (handoff comment 19133861). It does not repeat the coherent-block flow or the shared-chart and complementary-terminal bills.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/independent-chart-pair-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-chart-pair-ceiling
```

Python 3.12 standard library. Both commands passed, marker `PASS_INDEPENDENT_CHART_PAIR_CEILING`, package outcome `negative-result`. The verifier rebuilds the graph and enumerates 261,632 same-chart pairs, 261,632 partner pairs, and 8,355,872 rank-8 pairs. Distance-2 rank-0 pairs and edgeless sets are algebraic. Rejection controls: the identity histogram, `d*` with its rank-1 payment removed, and two copies of `d*` plus the same-chart or partner correction.

Not run: predecessor C++ maxflow, native phase suite, Lean, selected-frontier replay.

## Open next questions

See `research/independent-chart-pair-ceiling/README.md`.

1. One rank-0 path of three contacts with independent charts. `1022^3` is beyond this screen, and no multi-label reduction is proved.
2. One changed role-dependent route, other than a chart retag, with a 640-input endpoint and a full bill. The naive Y-exit lift remains stopped.
